### int-bzt52c11-gate-clamp

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-bzt52c11-gate-clamp" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-bzt52c11-c92321` (this record)
- **Conditions:** D8 across the Q1 gate-source (cathode on VBUS\_IN, anode on Net-(Q1-G)) bounds |Vgs| to the 10.4-11.6 V window in every reachable state that would otherwise exceed the AO3401A +/-12 V Vgs abs-max (unprogrammed 20 V PDO3 attach: -12.82 V unclamped; D5 clamp event with VBEN asserted: -20.77 V unclamped), with clamp current R12-limited to ~161 uA at 20 V and ~382 uA at 32.4 V per dec-e-q1-20v-gate-guard; sub-knee behavior at the 15 V operating point and gate soft-start with the added junction capacitance are the recorded bench residuals
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH
